summary_md: **Nathan AI Lab（互fo, CD后马上回） ([@KOF97AI](https://x.com/KOF97AI/status/2116010142407995601))** describes **Hypit**, which lets agents clone a viral YouTube or TikTok video into a workflow of beats, shots, captions, B-roll, sound and transitions, anchoring effects to words rather than timestamps and rendering motion in code to produce many variants cheaply ([hypit-ai/hypit](https://github.com/hypit-ai/hypit)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - hypit-ai/hypit: Clone any viral video with AI agents. Not just a script, the whole workflow: swap the face, the words, the B-roll, ship 100 variants in one command, and get your 100M views.

relevance: Structural video cloning for agentic production.
